technical-data.invention-title: WAVE ENERGY IMPROVEMENT UNIT TO BE CONVERTED INTO ELECTRIC POWER
UNITE D'AMELIORATION DE L'ENERGIE DES VAGUES A TRANSFORMER

abstract.p: The invention relates to a unit for production of electric power using the energy of the sea waves (13). This unit can work coupled with the already existing maritime infra-structures (7), such as moles, pontoon bridges, ports, docks, etc. The innovation of the system results from the improvement of the energy exploring the different condition of the sea between the two sides (4, 5) of the infra-structure (7) (mole, port, etc.): the open sea on one side with all its potential and kinetic available energy: on the other side a stabilised surface and with potential and kinetic energy practically dissipated. Improvement unit to convert sea waves energy into electric energy, changing the kinetic and potential enenergy of waves into energy of position, being based on the difference of heights of the free surfaces of the two tanks (1, 3) set in the mole (7), one located on the seaside (4), tank of reception (1) and the other one (3) located under the sheltered area (5), inside a port on the land side, where a hydraulic turbine (8) will be installed, passing the water from one tank to another through a tubing system (2) with draining pressure, which will feed a hydraulic turbine (8) that will produce electric energy. The system is modelling being possible to install in several units functioning in parallel alongside the mole.

L'invention concerne une unité de production d'électricité exploitant l'énergie des vagues (13) qui peut être couplée à des infrastructures marines (7) existant déjà, notamment des môles, des ponts d'équipage, des ports, des docks, etc. Le caractère innovateur de ce système tient de l'amélioration apportée à l'énergie grâce à l'exploration de conditions marines différentes entre les deux côtés (4, 5) de l'infrastructure (7) (môle, port, etc.), à savoir la mer ouverte sur un côté présente une énergie disponible potentielle et cinétique et la surface stabilisée présente une énergie potentielle et cinétique pratiquement dissipée de l'autre côté. L'unité d'amélioration sert à transformer l'énergie des vagues en électricité, à modifier l'énergie potentielle et cinétique des vagues en énergie de position en fonction de la différence de hauteur des surfaces libres des deux réservoirs (1, 3), le réservoir de réception (1) se trouvant dans le môle (7) côté mer (4) et l'autre réservoir (3) placé sous la zone protégée (5) dans un port côté terre. L'eau est acheminée d'un réservoir à l'autre à travers une canalisation (2) sous pression d'évacuation, ce qui alimente une turbine hydraulique (8) servant à produire de l'électricité. Ce système peut être monté dans plusieurs unités fonctionnant en parallèle le long du môle.

WAVE ENERGY IMPROVEMENT UNIT TO BE CONVERTED
INTO ELECTRIC POWER

The invention relates to an unit for production of electric power using the energy of sea waves. This unit con work coupled with the already existing maritime infra-structures, such as moles, pontoon bridges, ports, docks, etc.

The innovation of the system results from the improvement of the energy exploring the different conditions of the sea between the two sides of the infra-structure (mole, port, etc.): the open sea on one side with all its potential and kinetic available energy, an the other side a stabilized surface and with potencial and kinetic energy practically dissipated.
The functionning of the process is based on the working principle of a siphon, that is, if there exists a difference of height between two surfaces and if conditions of water
Circulation ore created, the draining is made from one side of the infra-structure to the other till the levels of the free levels of the surface between the two sides ore balanced.
In this unit the difference of heights between the free surfaces is secured by two tanks conceived to achieve the finest performance of those functions:
• Tank of reception (1 ) which is located an the seaside and therefore it is fed by the seawaves utilizing and converting the potential and kinetic energies into potential energy of position.

• Tank of the turbine (3) which is located on the other side of the mole, that is, inside the dock to receive and convert the energy accumulated inside the reception tank into electric power. So.
